note: Decisions the project needs. Status: open, proposed, decided, deferred. Record the outcome, date and who decided.

decisions.title: What is in scope?
decisions.question: Is this project the commercial LOS only, or does it also cover small business lending (today on Numerated)?
options: A. Commercial LOS only. Numerated stays for small business lending.
B. Commercial LOS plus small business lending ($250K-$500K), evaluated in the same RFP. Numerated stays only if it wins or is the better fit.
decisions.recommendation: B, if Numerated's contract terms allow it. Small business lending shares borrowers, credit policy and possibly the vendor (for example an all-in-one Abrigo platform).

decisions.title: Who sponsors and who leads?
decisions.question: Name the executive sponsor, the project lead, and how much of the project lead's time is committed.
decisions.recommendation: Executive sponsor from lending leadership; a project lead with at least 50% of their time on this through contract signature, rising during implementation.
decisions.outcome: Proposed: T. Chaves as executive sponsor and C. Alves as project lead. The project lead's time commitment is still to be agreed at kickoff.

decisions.title: Is renewing or renegotiating with GlobalWave a real option?
decisions.question: Should the evaluation treat staying with GlobalWave (possibly on new terms) as a valid outcome?
options: Yes: include GlobalWave in the RFI and RFP as a baseline.
No: the bank has already decided to leave.
decisions.recommendation: Yes, unless leadership has already ruled it out. It gives a cost baseline, negotiating leverage, and a fallback.

decisions.title: Target go-live date
decisions.question: Confirm the working target of 2028-08-01 for go-live.
decisions.recommendation: Keep 2028-08-01. It leaves about 7 months of buffer and avoids quarter-end and year-end.

decisions.title: Evaluation criteria and weights
decisions.question: Which criteria and weights will score vendors? Set them before any demo.
decisions.recommendation: Start from the draft list on the Options page. Weight admin burden and integrations heavily given a part-time admin model.

decisions.title: Budget envelope
decisions.question: What budget range is approved for evaluation, implementation and the first 3 years of licensing?
decisions.recommendation: Set a range now, then refine with RFP pricing.

decisions.title: Outside help
decisions.question: Will the bank use a consultant for the RFP or the implementation?
decisions.recommendation: Decide after the staffing discussion. With a part-time admin, implementation oversight is worth pricing.
